title: 丰田副社长：全球布局，应对区域经济模式变化
speaker: Koji Sato

segments.en: compete with Chinese rivals especially at a time when the Chinese market itself seems to be pretty
segments.zh: 与中国对手竞争，尤其是在中国市场本身似乎相当

segments.en: weak. Not just in China but globally as I mentioned earlier as economies become more protectionists
segments.zh: 疲软的时候。不仅在中国，全球范围内，随着经济保护主义抬头

segments.en: regional economic models are changing since the Japanese automotive industry operates worldwide
segments.zh: 区域经济模式正在变化，由于日本汽车产业在全球运营

segments.en: rather than fixating on a specific place we must build an environment where the Japanese automotive
segments.zh: 而不是局限于特定地区，我们必须构建一个环境，让日本汽车产业

segments.en: industry can compete effectively in any region of the world. Toyota Vice Chairman Koji Sato speaking
segments.zh: 能在世界任何地区有效竞争。丰田副社长佐藤恒治的发言
